_readme: Ontario energy rate assumptions + usage benchmarks for the bills estimator. These are deliberately conservative all-in estimates (commodity + delivery + charges). Update asOf whenever you revise. The estimator mostly works from the user's DOLLAR spend, so small rate drift doesn't break results — rates matter only for unit conversion and benchmarking.

ontario.gasPerM3Note: All-in estimate per m³ (Enbridge commodity + delivery; consumer carbon charge ended April 2025). Verify against a current bill.
ontario.elecPerKwhNote: Blended all-in estimate per kWh including delivery/regulatory. TOU/ULO plans vary.

benchmarks._note: Rough annual usage for a ~1,500–2,000 sq ft detached home, before era and size multipliers.
